Select 1×, 2× or 4× Z width below the view. Each selection loads its own CAD and downloads. Z uses a full-depth NEMA17 with 40 mm travel, attached only through its base face. The ribbed carrier runs parallel to the wide Z output flange. The upright 1× NEMA14 radial actuator sits bottom-down on the carrier and retains 120 mm travel.

Universal base holes accept printed-screw and T8 patterns. Widened and extended T8 patterns are inferred. Mounting coordinates · Mounting parts · STL

The radial motor sits 140 mm behind Z to counterbalance the forward stage. Its longer body and screw preserve reach and 120 mm travel. Z is raised for its rear controller with 10 mm of clearance below the reserved envelope. A 28 mm corner gusset carries a longer M4 mounting bolt. Pivots are 350 mm from board center on a 900 × 900 mm platform. Both linear screws have an 8 mm lead; physical stiffness and probing accuracy remain untested.

The shared rotary base is unchanged: 12/72 teeth, four tilted 625ZZ rollers, lightened base and deck, and a slotted Ø15.25 mm central spindle for the 6002 bearings. Right-click to download, isolate, hide or show all parts and toggle hidden edges.

Green translucent volumes reserve space for the rear controller components and USB cables. Component height, spacers and cables are provisional allowances. Load capacity, stiffness, contact force, print fit and accuracy remain untested. The checked module explosion separates one arm, removes the radial bottom-mount screws, and separates the new actuator modules. Actuator drives stay assembled; switch to Four arms for coordinated probing.

Based on FLEX, compliant-spur-gear, and the RP2040 motor controller.
